## @Rhobtor {.unlisted}

**PhD Student in Robotics and Mechatronics**  
University of Málaga

I work on field robotics, terrain-aware navigation, robotic perception, ROS 2 systems, and real-world unmanned ground vehicles.

This website collects my academic work, research projects, publications, software, and technical notes developed during my PhD.

## Current focus

- Terrain-aware navigation for unmanned ground vehicles.
- 2.5D elevation mapping and traversability estimation.
- Robotic perception using RGB-D, LiDAR and RGB-T sensors.
- MPPI-based local control and learning-based guidance.
- Real-world deployment with ROS 2, Docker and embedded GPU platforms.
